fields.acceptance: A testscript stops a fake run at a wait step with --no-wait, then a second rhiza run start on the change set exits 2 naming that run and rhiza run resume, and after the first run finishes a new start succeeds; a testscript fails a fake run, starts a second one stopped at a wait step, and rhiza run resume --retry on the failed run exits 2 naming the second; a Go test starts two runs on one change set concurrently and exactly one begins.
fields.statement: A change set has at most one live run: rhiza run start refuses a change set whose run's journal has not finished (done or failed), an interrupted run included, exiting 2 with the run's ID and a next step of rhiza run resume, and rhiza run resume (with or without --retry) refuses a run whose change set has another live run, exiting 2 naming that run; each checks and opens or reopens the journal under one lock so two concurrent starts or resumes never both begin.
